Thanks, Jerremy, that matches. I've got the order up, two Bitfortun BS-2 units, shipped back in September.

I can't see a return label issued against the RMA yet, so I've pinged the team to get the shipping instructions and label out to you. Stay in the chat if you can, one of them will jump in here, and if you step away the answer comes to your email.

One thing they'll ask: was either unit overclocked or modified?
ok.  Neither one was overclocked nor modified.  One unit is fine.  The other one had a heatsink glued on sideways.  I submitted photos with the RMA request

Got it, stock and untouched, so it's covered. A heatsink glued on crooked is a build fault, not something you caused.

I've added that to the note for the team: one of the two units, photos already with your RMA, label needed for that one only. You keep the good unit running, nothing to send back on it.

They'll come back here with the return label and address.
great
Used the chat-interview skill
Ran dossier.py (chat-interview skill)
Before you go, one thing: what made you go with two BS-2s rather than a single bigger miner?
If something happened to 1 it would not take out all my mining cap····

Makes sense, and ironic given one arrived faulty. With the B30 on your other order coming in November, is that meant to be the main machine, or do you plan to keep stacking smaller units alongside it?
Probably have all of them run together, but I'll need to look at power consumption
Power's the real constraint at home. Is it the circuit you're worried about, or the bill? I can run the monthly draw and cost for (address hidden) against the B30 and the BS-2s if that helps.
The bill
Ran the power-cost calculator

The B30 pulls about 360 to 450 W, so roughly 0.4 kW running flat out, call it 290 kWh a month. At California rates that's the bulk of your bill right there. I don't want to guess the BS-2's draw, so let me confirm that figure and come back with the three of them totalled.

Anything else while I'm here?
nope that would be helpful
Read the bitfortun bs 2 page

Got it. The B.2 is about 150 W at the wall, so your two draw roughly 300 W. Add the B30 at 360 to 450 W and all three sit near 700 W, call it 510 kWh a month running 24/7.

(address hidden) rates are high, so at 30 cents a kWh that's around $155 a month. Tell me your actual per-kWh rate and I'll redo it exactly.

The label for the faulty BS-2 is still with the team, they'll post it here.
I can't access that easily right now

No problem. Keep 700 W and 510 kWh a month as your number, then just multiply by whatever rate is on your bill. At 25 cents it's about $128 a month, at 35 cents about $179.

Nothing else needed from you right now. The team has the RMA and will post the return label and address here.
ok great

Glad that helps. Hang about for a few minutes and one of the team will drop the return label in here, and it goes to the email on your order either way.

If you're not in it already, our Discord is worth joining for setup and power questions: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf
any luck with the RMA details?

Nothing new on my side yet, the label hasn't been issued. It's with Abel and Georges now and it's near the end of their day Friday, so if nobody posts it here in the next while it'll come by email on Monday.

Nothing more you need to do, and don't ship the unit back until that label arrives.
should it come as an email from helium deploy.com if I don't get it here soon?

Yes, from us, to the email on the order, (email hidden) Worth checking spam, the tracking mail from your shipment landed oddly for a lot of people.

If it's not there by Monday afternoon, come back here with the order number and I'll chase it again.

Sounds good, Jerremy. I'll keep the chat open on my side, so if the label comes through you'll see it right here.
